name: lunch_decider
description: Can't decide what to eat? Let the Oracle guide your lunch decisions.

yes.question: Do you have more than 30 minutes?

yes.decision: Make a big pot of chili — you've got time, make it count!

no.decision: Grab spicy ramen — quick, hot, and packs a punch.

no.question: Are you in the mood for soup?

yes.decision: Tomato soup with grilled cheese — comfort in a bowl.

no.decision: Warm panini or toasted sandwich — hot, crispy, satisfying.

no.question: Are you looking for something healthy?

yes.decision: Big hearty salad with lots of toppings — kale, nuts, avocado.

no.decision: Grain bowl with quinoa, roasted veggies, and tahini dressing.

yes.decision: Quick sandwich or wrap — fuel up and get going.

no.decision: Charcuterie board — assemble meats, cheeses, crackers, and graze.
